notes: Refresh token exchange. Same endpoint as login. Same UA (axios/1.13.6). Body differs from login: uses `scope` field (login did not), no `code`/`redirect_uri`/`code_verifier`/`state`. The `scope` string contains 5 scopes (NOT 6 — `org:create_api_key` is absent, since we don't need console scope at runtime). Scope order in request is NOT alphabetical and NOT identical to `CLAUDE_AI_OAUTH_SCOPES` array source order — it's: profile, inference, sessions:claude_code, mcp_servers, file_upload. Likely the exact runtime order the code assembles. Content-Length 306 bytes for this sample (will vary with refresh_token length). Captured by forcing `expiresAt` to past — not by invalidating `accessToken` (see notes on `/oauth/refresh_behavior.md`).
